protected_boundaries: no production apply from research lanes
status/progress caches must not override immutable evidence
warm_resume_policy: Verify same lane/contract and changed state/immutable progress; do not reread unchanged global authority documents.
cold_start_policy: Read the minimum authority chain needed to select the live task: live main, compact routing, selected live Issue/checkpoint, permanent safety rules, then task-specific specs only as needed.
current_dev_task_role: compatibility pointer only; do not duplicate routing state
progress_authority: immutable checkpoint/result first; status/progress summaries are derived cache
routing_stability_policy: do not embed fast-changing lane progress or required current branch HEAD; fetch those live
codex_execution_default: Project fixes WHAT/WHY/HARD BOUNDARIES/ACCEPTANCE; Codex chooses HOW, internal architecture, investigation method, work order, helper tooling and refactor granularity.
conflict_policy: Resolve harmless stale dashboards/pointers from higher-authority live state and continue. Stop only when unresolved conflict materially affects mutation, protected data, accepted semantics, production, or task contract.
checklist_policy: Issue checklists are guidance unless explicitly marked as hard acceptance/safety gates; low-value or obsolete planned steps may be skipped with evidence.
reuse_policy: For substantial commodity capability, Codex may prefer maintained OSS/data/patterns over local reinvention. Current project is private/local personal use: preserve upstream source when practical, but do not make formal license/provenance review a routine blocker. Re-audit before distribution/publication/shared-service/commercial use or when an obvious restriction appears.
deployment_scope: private single-user workstation; distribution-quality portability is not a default acceptance gate
change_review_policy: Use branch/PR for substantial, semantic, UserData, production, or risky work. Trivial reversible docs/metadata/maintenance may use the simplest safe route.
network_policy: External/network-backed features are allowed when useful; preserve local-state safety and keep secrets out of the repository. Offline is a preference, not a universal hard requirement.
packaging_policy: Self-contained/single-file/no-PDB/second-PC/folder-copy/machine-independent-path checks are optional unless a specific task needs them.
